phase.name: phase_1_chat_parity
phase.reason: O_CHAT_PARALLEL control6 already made useful-output adequacy a hard root gate, but the role-authoritative files readable by evaluation and evidence_comparator still mirrored control5-era duplicate-only methods. A hard gate that workers cannot receive through their permitted control path is not executable Phase-1 proof.

actual_execution_authority.assignment_reason: The active 14-role specialization remains on the Phase-1 critical path; this run synchronizes method contracts rather than reallocating roles.

control_plane_acceptance_drift.observation: O_CHAT_PARALLEL control6 requires useful_output_opportunity_count>=20 and useful_output_rate>=0.80 plus a low-usefulness negative control, while DESIRED_STATE control19 evaluation assignment and DOWNSTREAM_STATE control28 trace/evidence contracts still referenced the older duplicate-only control5 acceptance method.
control_plane_acceptance_drift.execution_observation: The 00:59 evaluation invocation correctly froze root control19/config6, did not author or execute a new checker, and preserved a continuation that only required the duplicate negative and matched no-duplicate positive. Because CLEAN evaluation is forbidden to read O_CHAT_PARALLEL, it could not infer the new usefulness controls from control6.
control_plane_acceptance_drift.scope: Repository control propagation and Phase-1 acceptance method only; no claim is made that real worker useful-output rate is below threshold.

changes_this_run.reason: Expose the control6 usefulness hard-gate method through the sanitized root overlay CLEAN evaluation is actually allowed to read, including durable precommit-before-execution and three aggregate controls.
Synchronize the independent verifier and acceptance coordinator to O_CHAT control6 so useful-output opportunity/rate is a hard gate rather than hidden portfolio-only policy.

critical_path: Evaluation must fresh-bootstrap root20/config6, author checker-v2 without executing, durably precommit/read back checker identity and all three control oracles, persist/read back checker-v2, then execute.
The unchanged duplicate-effect negative control must fail.
A >=20-opportunity useful-output negative control with useful_output_rate < 0.80 must fail even when all other hard gates pass.
A matched >=20-opportunity positive control with useful_output_rate >= 0.80 may pass only when every aggregate hard requirement holds.
Evidence comparator config13 must independently fetch durable artifacts and rederive both aggregate gate families rather than accept producer self-assertion.
Automation optimizer config26 must independently reconcile all three controls and all 14 active cells before Phase-1 closure.

rollback.condition: Rollback only if the synchronized useful-output controls prevent safe role-local checkpointing or independently reject an adequate >=20-opportunity trace solely because of schema/transport error. Never weaken CLEAN isolation, duplicate/conflict/authority gates, base restoration, primary-O boundaries, or scheduler constraints.

termination.reason: Material control-propagation defect repaired; checker-v2 controls and current/equivalent role proofs remain unresolved.

exact_next_action: Validate the first evaluation invocation that freezes DESIRED_STATE control20 and verify durable precommit occurs before first checker-v2 execution.
Require durable failure of both duplicate-effect and low-usefulness negatives plus matched positive pass only under every hard gate.
Validate the first evidence_comparator config13 independent recomputation of those controls.
Continue validating neuroscience current Phase-1 own-probe and novelty config15 exact-fetch bootstrap-binding receipts.
Reconcile all 14 active cells; do not enter Phase 2 until every active cell and aggregate hard gate is durably proven.
